path_section_content_1: After a few years studying agricultural engineering, I realized that path was not for me. My interest then shifted to IT, particularly web, mobile, and software development. I started by learning the basics of Java, then successfully completed a Bachelor's Degree in Management Information Systems.
path_section_content_2: I gained my first experience as a consultant, assigned to a mission in a company specializing in the development of IT solutions for the pharmaceutical sector.
path_section_content_3: Despite the doubts generated by the complexity of the current job market, I decided to embark on a solo adventure to master my projects. Welcome to my portfolio! Feel free to contact me for any collaboration. Explore my achievements below.
projects_list_subtitle: Explore my technical and artistic achievements.
project_description_longlove: Mobile App for Long-Distance Couples (React Native)
cardforge_title: CardForge - The Custom Top Trumps Creator
cardforge_subtitle: Moddable & Competitive Card Game (Modern Web Technologies)
cardforge_description: CardForge is an online card game project inspired by the famous 'Top Trumps' principle, but with an unparalleled creative and communal dimension: the ability for players to create their own decks from scratch. Tired of games with predefined cards, the goal is to offer a platform where imagination is the only limit, allowing confrontation of any theme, character, or concept.
cardforge_objective: CardForge's ambition is to develop a robust and intuitive browser-based gaming environment that supports not only classic 'Top Trumps' gameplay but also a powerful card and deck editor. Technical challenges include dynamic management of card schemas (variable characteristics), user data persistence (created decks), and a real-time interface for multiplayer games. The aim is to prove that a web-based card game can be rich, customizable, and competitive.
cardforge_feature_1: **Advanced Deck Editor:** Create cards with custom names, descriptions, images, and definable statistics (strength, agility, intelligence, etc.).
cardforge_feature_2: **"Top Trumps" Gameplay:** Challenge other players online in strategic duels, where knowledge of your deck and luck determine the winner.
cardforge_feature_3: **Collection Management:** Organize, modify, and share your custom decks with the community.
cardforge_feature_4: **Intelligent Matchmaking:** Quickly find opponents based on your preferences and deck availability.
cardforge_feature_5: **Community System:** Rate, comment on, and discover decks created by other players.
finovo_description: Finovo is an initiative aimed at revolutionizing current Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software. Observing widespread dissatisfaction with existing solutions, often rigid and costly, I set out to develop a modern and flexible alternative. Finovo is designed to adapt precisely to the real needs of each company, without overloading clients with superfluous features or unjustified costs.
finovo_objective: The main objective of Finovo is to prove that a complete ERP solution can be modular, powerful, and customizable. The initial priority is the development of a robust invoicing module, capable of generating invoices in Peppol-compatible XML format. Ultimately, Finovo aims to become a comprehensive, scalable, and economical ERP, based on a microservices architecture.
finovo_feature_1: **Advanced Invoicing:** Creation and management of invoices, quotes, and credit notes.
finovo_feature_2: **Peppol Compatibility:** Generation of invoices in standardized XML format for European exchanges.
finovo_feature_3: **Microservices Architecture:** Each module is independent, ensuring flexibility, scalability, and resilience.
finovo_feature_4: **Intuitive User Interface:** Frontend developed with React for a modern and responsive user experience.
finovo_feature_5: **Robust API:** Backend built with FastAPI (Python) for high performance and automatic API documentation.
finovo_roadmap_item_1: **Customer Relationship Management (CRM):** Tracking leads, clients, and managing business opportunities.
finovo_roadmap_item_2: **Inventory & Logistics Management:** Inventory optimization, tracking goods flows, and warehouse management.
finovo_roadmap_item_3: **Accounting & Finance:** Comprehensive module for bookkeeping, budget tracking, and financial reporting.
finovo_roadmap_item_4: **Human Resources (HR):** Employee management, leave, payroll, and recruitment.
finovo_roadmap_item_5: **Extensive Customization:** A configurable dashboard and reports tailored to each business.
finovo_roadmap_item_6: **Cloud & On-Premise Deployment:** Flexible deployment options to suit client preferences.
justgaming_title: JustGaming - The Social Network for Gamers
justgaming_description: JustGaming originated from the bold idea of four Management Information Systems bachelor students, eager to create a social platform dedicated to video game enthusiasts. The goal was to build a space where gamers could meet, share, and, most importantly, easily find partners for their gaming sessions. It's a response to the isolation sometimes felt in the online gaming world, offering a comprehensive community hub.
justgaming_objective: This project aimed to demonstrate the feasibility of a dynamic social network with effective tools and technologies. The use of Django for the backend allowed for robust management of user data and social interactions, while the integration of HTMX on the frontend was a strategic choice to offer a fluid and responsive user experience, without the complexities of a heavy JavaScript framework.
justgaming_feature_1: **Game Partner Search:** Advanced system to find teammates based on games, platforms, and play styles.
justgaming_feature_2: **Dynamic News Feed:** Sharing of statuses, screenshots, videos, and gaming-related news among friends and communities.
justgaming_feature_3: **Instant Messaging (Messenger Like):** Private and group communication to coordinate games and chat.
justgaming_feature_4: **Customizable User Profiles:** Display of favorite games, statistics, and gaming preferences.
justgaming_feature_5: **Groups and Communities:** Creation and management of communities around specific games or common interests.
longlove_title: LongLove - Connecting Hearts from a Distance
longlove_subtitle: Mobile App for Couples (React Native & Node.js/Firebase)
longlove_description: LongLove is an innovative mobile application designed to strengthen the bonds of couples in long-distance relationships. Born from the observation that distance can sometimes alter spontaneity and closeness, LongLove offers a private and enriched space, facilitating communication, sharing, and playful activities, so that distance is no longer a barrier to love.
longlove_objective: The main objective is to provide a complete digital toolkit for long-distance relationships. LongLove aims to recreate strong intimacy and emotional connection through intuitive and engaging features, making every distant day sweeter and more connected. The project will explore the specific challenges of cross-platform mobile development with React Native and the integration of backend services for real-time functionalities.
longlove_feature_1: **Enriched Messaging:** Exchange text, voice messages, photos, and videos in a private and secure environment.
longlove_feature_2: **Shared Calendar:** Synchronization of important dates, management of couple events, and countdowns to the next meeting.
longlove_feature_3: **Playful Activities & Couple Games:** Personalized quizzes, daily challenges, and a collaborative drawing space to have fun together.
longlove_feature_4: **Memory Gallery:** A private and organized photo/video album to immortalize shared moments and precious memories.
longlove_feature_5: **Mood Sharing & Haptic Notifications:** Quickly send your mood and gentle vibrations to simulate distant "touches."
longlove_feature_6: **"Love Letters":** A dedicated space for writing intimate messages, kept as treasures of the relationship.
mytasker_description: MyTasker is a desktop application designed to facilitate project and task management. Developed with WPF (Windows Presentation Foundation), the main objective of this project was to explore and master the basics of this Microsoft technology, thus opening the door to the development of rich and powerful Windows applications.
mytasker_objective: MyTasker's primary ambition was to immerse myself in the WPF ecosystem. It involved learning how to structure a desktop application, manage user interactions, and manipulate data through a modern graphical interface.
mytasker_feature_1: Project Management: Create, Read, Update, and Delete (CRUD).
mytasker_feature_2: Person Management: Create, Read, Update, and Delete (CRUD).
mytasker_feature_3: Task Management: Create, Read, Update, and Delete (CRUD).
mytasker_feature_4: Intuitive Assignment: Link tasks to specific people within each project.
mytasker_feature_5: Clear Visualization: Dedicated views for each entity to organize information.
nisolnicole_description: NisolNicole is a web platform dedicated to a local author, designed to present her literary work to the public. The first version is an elegant showcase, offering an immersion into her universe and facilitating the discovery of her writings. This project illustrates the ability to build full-stack applications, combining the responsiveness of the Vue3 frontend with the robustness of a .NET/C# backend.
nisolnicole_objective: The main objective of V1 was to create a professional online presence for the author, familiarizing myself with the specifics of Vue3 for the user interface and establishing a RESTful API with .NET/C#. Future versions aim to transform this showcase into a complete e-commerce platform, highlighting an evolving and user-experience-focused development approach.
nisolnicole_feature_v1_1: Immersive Home Page presenting the author's universe.
nisolnicole_feature_v1_2: "My Writings" page to discover publications, with external links to paper book ordering platforms.
nisolnicole_feature_v1_3: Contact Page for easy interaction with the author.
nisolnicole_feature_v1_4: Responsive Design ensuring a fluid user experience on all devices.
nisolnicole_feature_v1_5: Lightweight .NET/C# Backend for potential dynamic content management (ready for evolution).
nisolnicole_roadmap_item_1: **V2: Full E-commerce Integration** - Addition of an online store with catalog management and secure purchasing process via the Stripe API.
nisolnicole_roadmap_item_2: **V3: Community Space** - Implementation of a news feed for announcements and events, and a "Workshop" page for literary workshops.
nisolnicole_roadmap_item_3: **SEO & Performance Optimization** - Improvement of search engine optimization and overall site performance.
portfolio_subtitle: A Technological Showcase Built with React & Holographic CSS
portfolio_description: This portfolio is not just a simple collection of projects; it's a project in itself, designed to offer an immersive and modern experience. The goal was to create a dynamic and visually distinctive platform that reflects not only my technical skills in frontend web development but also my ability to innovate in presenting my work. Inspired by futuristic sci-fi interfaces, it adopts a unique holographic theme.
portfolio_objective: The main objective was to design a portfolio that stands out, using the latest frontend technologies for optimal performance and a polished aesthetic. Challenges included implementing the holographic effect via CSS, managing SPA navigation with React Router, optimizing performance for animations, and designing a modular and maintainable component structure. It's a demonstration of my mastery of React and my creativity in interface design.
portfolio_feature_1: **Holographic Interface:** Unique visual design with translucent elements, glow effects, and subtle animations for a futuristic rendering.
portfolio_feature_2: **Fluid SPA Navigation:** Use of React Router for a seamless page navigation experience, fast and intuitive.
portfolio_feature_3: **Modular Components:** Code structure organized into reusable and easily maintainable React components.
portfolio_feature_4: **Mobile-First Responsiveness:** Design adapted to a wide range of devices, from desktops to smartphones, for maximum accessibility.
portfolio_feature_5: **Font Awesome Icon Integration:** Use of an icon library to enhance the aesthetic and visual understanding of features.
portfolio_feature_6: **State Management (Hooks):** Use of React hooks to efficiently manage component state and side effects.
